      "observations": [
        "Read all 70 eligible owned paths and all 2,741 lines of the historical export. No Suite path or conditional branch occurs in the checked owned sides. Every owned file delta matches the explicit key-spelling replacements plus whitespace, including the tree-view info message and tabmail call wrapping. No production implementation, import, assertion or listener algorithm is changed.",
        "The migration uses KEY_Delete, KEY_Backspace, KEY_Escape, KEY_Enter, KEY_Tab, KEY_Arrow*, KEY_Page*, KEY_Home/End, KEY_F* and KEY_Alt for non-printable cases. Printable VK_SPACE, VK_PERIOD and VK_COMMA become literal space, period and comma. Command manifest shortcut strings and modifier objects remain separate from the synthetic key input.",
        "All 70 owned files contain no VK_ after the landing. Their 69 extant fixed-accepted counterparts also contain none; this is a literal source check, not a whole-repository completeness or native equivalence result. Fifteen whole files are identical at accepted, 54 have later changes, and browser_alarmDefaultValue.js is absent there. Those later phases are not credited to this landing.",
        "The actual shared Calendar, Compose, FolderDisplay and Keyboard helpers import the mail EventUtils namespace. Reused exact accepted helper excerpts document KEY_ non-printable names and plain printable strings. BrowserTestUtils calls and harness-global EventUtils calls are distinct receivers; their Gecko implementation/native dispatch remains bounded unread context.",
        "Wrapper completion stays local: Calendar deletion registers and awaits a dialog promise; press_delete plans DeleteOrMoveMsgCompleted or DeleteOrMoveMsgFailed and waits for FolderListener; that listener accepts the first listed event from any folder, not successful deletion. The tree-view wrapper awaits a select condition and checks a delay in its single-selection case. The listbox wrapper instead observes select synchronously; expansion delegates to its own performChange.",
        "Direct test expectations remain unchanged: tree tests assert current/selected rows, event-time values, collapse/expand state and classes; the details test asserts open/closed transitions for click, literal space and Enter; the extension test awaits onCommand and checks command name/tab type. Attachment-reordering expected arrays, platform branches, target windows and modifiers are preserved. These are assertions in source, not executed outcomes.",
        "Manual checks: input names follow the actual test-helper API and preserve stored/public shortcut names. Existing comments explain target focus, popup closure and sequence constraints. The newly wrapped tabmail multiline call could be separated from the surrounding selection assertions for clearer action/result groups; this is a scoped readability suggestion. The patch adds no assertions. Nearby existing assertions without messages remain, including the attendee popup count/index checks and address-book row-count checks; missing should alone is not a defect.",
        "The original primary explicitly limits the work to tests. Its earlier small Escape migration, this broader landing, later reopening for residual Calendar names and final transfer to Bug 2054903 are distinct phases. Search results, dependency bodies and production keysets are not inferred from the title.",
        "Discussion reconciliation uses primary original e76b996d53fcaa7d523cd04a5af552325ffb4c4dc00d1832ef454ada626510f9 with original Parent reader/time and C review original 72c240c9f01696db17783a2c9683278bb0c205360e15fd192812d1c3ea30d527. A read the retained bodies locally; neither copied text nor a new independent browser confirmation was created.",
        "D297160 has zero actual inline bodies, four actual summary Old/New pairs and two actual test-plan Old/New pairs. Historical summaries explicitly name literal printable exceptions and intentionally retain the unrelated XUL keycode assertions and unchanged mail EventUtils implementation; later summary deletion does not retract those inspected source distinctions. Actual owned source adopts the printable spellings and leaves those two files outside the changed path set.",
        "The initial test plan lists targeted tests, directory suites, a broader regression sweep and literal VK_ checks; the later plan reduces this to checking changed-file spelling and affected test success. The source grep establishes only the literal spelling fact. A submitted Try URL, earlier lint defects/failed builds and later remote-build completions are historical reports; their jobs and diagnostics were not opened and no fresh test or lint ran.",
